summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for configuring automatic watermark intervals in Flink DataStream applications. It does not match any existing skill in the registry (which contains unrelated skills: Executor Submit/Future, vLLM Generation Server). Peer candidates are other Flink micro_skills in different task families (buffer timeout, text file source, sink output) with different objectives and methods. No semantic overlap, merge, split, or revision relationship exists.
